svg.title: ROBOTSOCCER detailed electrical reference, revision B
svg.text: PROPOSAL — NOT A PCB NETLIST OR BENCH-VALIDATED CIRCUIT
P = module pad number; GPIO ≠ pad number
Tie duplicated output pins as labeled.
Verify installed motor polarity with wheels raised.
Do not route motor return through MCU ground traces.
Hold BOOT, pulse RESET, release BOOT.
GPIO4–7: do not use JTAG with motors armed.
Dashed power blocks require real-part selection. All GND symbols share one star-return net; crossings without dots are not connections.
Decoupling must be placed at IC pins. Verify current, thermal behavior, cutoff and VM transients before operation.
Sheet 1 / 1 · Component pads checked against primary datasheets
